discription: A thick, detuned pulse wave synth with an ADSR envelope and a chorus effect.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, detune=0.005, pan=0;    var sig, env;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth);    sig = sig + Pulse.ar(freq * (1 + detune), pulseWidth);    sig = sig + Pulse.ar(freq * (1 - detune), pulseWidth);    sig = (sig / 3) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
